spots.name: Place de la Bourse & Miroir d'eau
spots.desc: 18th-century grand square set along the riverfront, home to the world's largest water mirror reflecting classical facades.

spots.name: Grand Théâtre de Bordeaux
spots.desc: Masterpiece of 18th-century Neoclassical architecture featuring a portico of 12 Corinthian columns topped by muses and goddesses.

spots.name: Cathédrale Saint-André & Tour Pey-Berland
spots.desc: Gothic cathedral where Eleanor of Aquitaine married Louis VII, paired with a freestanding bell tower offering city views.

spots.name: Porte Cailhau
spots.desc: 15th-century white stone city gate standing 35 meters tall, built to commemorate King Charles VIII's victory at Fornovo.

spots.name: Grosse Cloche
spots.desc: Historic 15th-century belfry of the former town hall, featuring twin conical towers and a massive 7,800kg bronze bell.

spots.name: Basilique Saint-Michel & Flèche Saint-Michel
spots.desc: Flamboyant Gothic basilica crowned by a freestanding 114m spire, one of the tallest in southern France.

spots.name: Monument aux Girondins (Place des Quinconces)
spots.desc: Monumental 54-meter column topped by a bronze statue of Liberty, flanked by dramatic fountains honoring the Girondin martyrs.

spots.name: Palais Gallien (Gallo-Roman Amphitheatre)
spots.desc: Atmospheric arches and wall ruins of a 2nd-century Roman amphitheatre that once seated 15,000 spectators.

spots.name: Pont de Pierre
spots.desc: Historic 17-arch stone bridge commissioned by Napoleon I, connecting the left bank with the Bastide district.

spots.name: Château de Roquetaillade
spots.desc: Imposing medieval castle fortress in Mazères restored by Viollet-le-Duc, showcasing intact feudal towers and interior furnishings.

spots.name: Château de La Brède (Montesquieu Estate)
spots.desc: Moated Gothic castle surrounded by parkland where political philosopher Montesquieu was born and wrote 'The Spirit of Laws'.

spots.name: Cité du Vin
spots.desc: Futuristic decanter-shaped museum along the Garonne offering interactive exhibits on global wine culture and belvedere wine tasting.

spots.name: Bassins des Lumières
spots.desc: World's largest digital art center housed inside a WWII German submarine base, projecting monumental masterpieces over water basins.

spots.name: Musée d'Aquitaine
spots.desc: Regional history museum covering Bordeaux from prehistoric origins through Roman Gaul, medieval trade, and the transatlantic era.

spots.name: Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux
spots.desc: Prestigious fine arts museum in Palais Rohan wings displaying masterpieces by Titian, Rubens, Delacroix, and Matisse.

spots.name: CAPC Musée d'Art Contemporain
spots.desc: Avant-garde contemporary art museum set in a majestic 19th-century colonial warehouse with vaulted brick halls.

spots.name: MADD (Musée des Arts Décoratifs et du Design)
spots.desc: Housed in the 18th-century Hôtel de Lalande townhouse, showcasing period furniture, ceramics, and contemporary design exhibitions.

spots.name: Musée Mer Marine
spots.desc: Modern maritime museum in the Bassins à Flot district tracing navigation history, ocean exploration, and marine conservation.

spots.name: Musée National des Douanes
spots.desc: France's only customs museum, located inside Place de la Bourse, showcasing contraband artifacts, smuggling history, and uniforms.

spots.name: Marché des Capucins
spots.desc: Bustling indoor market known as 'the belly of Bordeaux', famous for fresh Arcachon oysters paired with chilled white wine.

spots.name: Brasserie Bordelaise
spots.desc: Vibrant traditional brasserie serving authentic Aquitaine duck fillet, entrecôte bordelaise, and regional wines.

spots.name: Canelé Baillardran & La Toque Cuivrée
spots.desc: Bordeaux's famous bakery boutiques crafting warm, caramelized rum-and-vanilla canelés baked in copper molds.

spots.name: Le Bar à Vin (CIVB)
spots.desc: Official Bordeaux Wine Council wine bar inside an 18th-century mansion offering sommelier-poured Grand Cru wines at factory prices.

spots.name: Café Français
spots.desc: Historic grand cafe with outdoor terrace seating directly facing the Cathedral of Saint-André.

spots.name: L'Entrecôte Bordeaux
spots.desc: Legendary restaurant near Grand Théâtre serving a single famous menu: sirloin steak with secret butter sauce and unlimited fries.

spots.name: Grand Cru Wineries (Saint-Émilion, Médoc)
spots.desc: World-renowned wine estates like Château Margaux and Château Pape Clément offering cellar tours and premier tastings.

spots.name: Quartier Saint-Pierre
spots.desc: Historic heart of old Bordeaux with narrow cobblestone alleys, shaded squares, wine bars, and lively restaurant terraces.

spots.name: Quartier des Chartrons
spots.desc: Historic wine merchants' quarter turned trendy bohemian neighborhood filled with antique shops, art galleries, and cafes.

spots.name: Les Quais de Bordeaux & Garonne Promenade
spots.desc: Vast 4.5km pedestrian riverfront promenade stretching from Place de la Bourse to Cité du Vin with gardens and skateparks.

spots.name: Rue Sainte-Catherine
spots.desc: Europe's longest pedestrian shopping street (1.2km) running straight through the historic center from Place de la Comédie.

spots.name: Place des Quinconces
spots.desc: One of Europe's largest city squares (12 hectares) lined with tree avenues overlooking the Garonne River.

spots.name: Darwin Eco-Système
spots.desc: Repurposed military barracks on the right bank turned alternative hub featuring organic bistro, indoor skatepark, and street art.

spots.name: Saint-Émilion Medieval Village (UNESCO)
spots.desc: UNESCO World Heritage medieval village famous for its monolithic underground church and rolling vineyard landscape.

spots.name: Dune du Pilat & Arcachon Bay
spots.desc: Europe's tallest sand dune (100m+) offering breathtaking views over Atlantic ocean pine forests and Arcachon oyster ports.

spots.name: Jardin Public & Muséum de Bordeaux
spots.desc: 18th-century English-style park featuring a duck lake, historic Guignol puppet theatre, playgrounds, and Natural History Museum.

spots.name: Cap Sciences
spots.desc: Interactive science discovery museum along the riverfront designed for kids and teens with hands-on tech workshops.

spots.name: Bordeaux River Cruise / Bat3 Water Taxi
spots.desc: Riverboat excursions and public catamaran water taxis providing panoramic views of Bordeaux's UNESCO riverfront facades.

spots.name: Parc Bordelais
spots.desc: Bordeaux's largest urban park (28 hectares) featuring farm animals, a miniature steam train, electric car circuit, and lake.

spots.name: Zoo de Bordeaux-Pessac
spots.desc: Suburban family zoo home to white tigers, giant pandas, and up-close animal feeding experiences.

spots.name: La Forêt des Accro-Batches
spots.desc: Tree-top adventure park set in maritime pine forest with zip-lines and obstacle courses for all skill levels.
